tasks.title: Create tasks table database migration

acceptance_criteria: Migration creates tasks table with all specified columns and correct data types
Migration is idempotent (can be run on a clean database without errors)
prisma migrate deploy completes successfully in CI pipeline
All column constraints (NOT NULL, DEFAULT, etc.) match approved schema

test_requirements.test_notes: Run migration against test PostgreSQL database. Verify schema via prisma db pull and compare to expected schema.

security_requirements.security_notes: Migration file only. No runtime security requirements. Verify migration does not drop or alter existing tables.

tasks.title: Define Task Prisma model
tasks.description: Adds the Task model to prisma/schema.prisma with all fields, relations to User model, and database indexes. Uses PrismaPg adapter conventions.
acceptance_criteria: Task model has all required fields with correct Prisma types
Relation to User model (created_by) is correctly mapped
Index on (status, created_by) is defined for query performance
prisma generate succeeds and produces correct TypeScript types
Model follows PrismaPg adapter conventions

test_requirements.test_notes: TypeScript compilation of generated Prisma client verifies schema correctness.

security_requirements.security_notes: Schema definition only. No runtime security requirements.

tasks.title: Implement createTask Server Action
tasks.description: Implements the createTask Server Action. Validates input with Zod CreateTaskSchema, persists via DAL, records audit_log entry, and returns the created Task object or an ActionResult error.
tasks.context_summary: This is the primary mutation entry point for task creation. It must: 1) Check authentication via NextAuth getServerSession, 2) Validate input with CreateTaskSchema (title: string min 3, status: enum, priority: enum, due_date: optional date), 3) Call the DAL createTaskRecord function, 4) Write audit_log entry with event type 'task.created'. Return type is ActionResult<Task> — a union of success/error. See Architecture.md §4.2 for the ActionResult pattern.
function_signatures: export const CreateTaskSchema = z.object({ title: z.string().min(3).max(255), description: z.string().optional(), status: z.enum(['todo', 'in_progress', 'done']), priority: z.enum(['low', 'medium', 'high']), due_date: z.date().optional() })
export async function createTask(input: CreateTaskInput): Promise<ActionResult<Task>>
acceptance_criteria: Function validates input using CreateTaskSchema and returns field-level Zod errors on invalid input
Function returns the created Task object on success
Function writes an audit_log entry with event type 'task.created' and user_id
Unauthenticated calls return { error: 'UNAUTHORIZED' } — no database write occurs
Function returns { error: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', fields: ... } on Zod validation failure
Function uses 'use server' directive at top of file

mock_requirements: Prisma client (vi.mock for unit tests; real test DB for integration)
NextAuth getServerSession (mock authenticated session and unauthenticated scenario)
test_requirements.test_notes: Unit test all code paths including validation failure, auth failure, and success. Integration test against real PostgreSQL test database.

security_requirements.security_notes: Use NextAuth getServerSession at function start. Parse input with CreateTaskSchema.safeParse before any database operation. Write to audit_log table before returning success response.

tasks.title: Implement GET /api/tasks Route Handler
tasks.description: Implements the GET /api/tasks Route Handler for fetching a paginated list of tasks belonging to the authenticated user. Returns tasks as JSON. Used by external clients and cron jobs.
function_signatures: export async function GET(request: NextRequest): Promise<NextResponse<TaskListResponse | ErrorResponse>>
type TaskListResponse = { tasks: Task[]; total: number; page: number; pageSize: number }
acceptance_criteria: Handler returns 401 for unauthenticated requests
Handler returns paginated list of tasks for authenticated user
Response conforms to TaskListResponse schema from API_Contract.json
Handler validates query params (page, pageSize, status filter) with Zod
Handler returns only tasks belonging to the authenticated user (no cross-user data leakage)

mock_requirements: Prisma client (real test DB for integration)
test_requirements.test_notes: Test pagination, filtering by status, unauthenticated access, and edge cases (empty result set, max pageSize).

security_requirements.security_notes: Check authentication first. Scope all DB queries to current user's ID. Never return tasks from other users.

tasks.title: Implement TaskList Server Component
tasks.description: Implements the TaskList Server Component that fetches and renders the list of tasks for the authenticated user. Uses Server Component data fetching (no SWR). Renders TaskCard per task.
function_signatures: export default async function TaskList({ userId }: { userId: string }): Promise<JSX.Element>
acceptance_criteria: Component renders a list of tasks fetched via Server Component (direct Prisma query or Server Action call)
Empty state is displayed when user has no tasks
Each task shows title, status, priority, and due_date
Component is accessible (semantic HTML, ARIA where needed)

test_requirements.e2e_flow_description: Authenticated user navigates to /tasks page. Tasks list renders with correct task titles, statuses, and priorities. Empty state shows when no tasks exist.
test_requirements.test_notes: Use Playwright to test with a seeded test database. Verify that only the authenticated user's tasks are shown.

security_requirements.security_notes: Wrap in authentication check. Server Component should verify session via getServerSession before fetching data.

tasks.title: Implement TaskForm Client Component
tasks.description: Implements the TaskForm Client Component for creating new tasks. Calls the createTask Server Action on submit. Handles loading states, validation errors, and success feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Form has fields for: title (required), description (optional), status, priority, due_date
Form calls createTask Server Action on submit
Loading state is shown while Server Action is pending
Validation errors from Zod are displayed per field
Success state navigates user back to task list or shows success toast

test_requirements.e2e_flow_description: Authenticated user clicks 'New Task', fills form with valid data, submits, and sees the new task appear in the task list. Also test: submit with empty required field shows error.
test_requirements.test_notes: Test happy path and validation error path via Playwright.

security_requirements.security_notes: Client Component only handles UI state. Security (auth, validation, audit) is enforced in the createTask Server Action (TASK-003).
